ex.en: The result confirmed my hypothesis.
ex.zh: 這個結果證實了我的假設。

ex.en: We have sufficient evidence to prove this hypothesis.
ex.zh: 我們有足夠的證據證明這個假設。

ex.en: This is just a hypothesis.
ex.zh: 這只是個假設。

ex.en: Scientists hypothesize that the virus came from bats.
ex.zh: 科學家推測這種病毒來自蝙蝠。

ex.en: We hypothesized that sleep affects memory.
ex.zh: 我們假設睡眠會影響記憶。

ex.en: Good hygiene helps prevent the spread of disease.
ex.zh: 良好的衛生習慣有助於防止疾病傳播。

ex.en: Restaurants must follow strict food hygiene rules.
ex.zh: 餐廳必須遵守嚴格的食品衛生規定。

ex.en: Dental hygiene is important for children.
ex.zh: 口腔衛生對孩子很重要。

ex.en: Our company uses a hybrid work model.
ex.zh: 我們公司採用混合辦公模式。

ex.en: The event will be in a hybrid format.
ex.zh: 活動將以實體加線上的混合形式舉辦。

hybrid.zh: 混合物、混種；油電混合車

ex.en: I drive a hybrid to save on gas.
ex.zh: 我開油電混合車來省油錢。

ex.en: This plant is a hybrid of two species.
ex.zh: 這種植物是兩個品種的雜交種。

ex.en: Hydrogen is the lightest element.
ex.zh: 氫是最輕的元素。

ex.en: Water consists of hydrogen and oxygen.
ex.zh: 水是由氫和氧組成的。

ex.en: Let me ask you a hypothetical question.
ex.zh: 我問你一個假設性的問題。

ex.en: This is just a hypothetical situation.
ex.zh: 這只是一個假設的情況。

hysterical.zh: 歇斯底里的、情緒失控的

ex.en: The hysterical crowd rushed toward the exit.
ex.zh: 歇斯底里的群眾衝向出口。

ex.en: She became hysterical when she heard the news.
ex.zh: 她聽到消息時情緒失控了。

ex.en: The comedian's story was absolutely hysterical.
ex.zh: 那位喜劇演員的故事實在笑死人了。

ex.en: We watched a hysterical movie last night.
ex.zh: 我們昨晚看了一部超爆笑的電影。

ex.en: He tells us not to smoke, but he smokes himself. What a hypocrite!
ex.zh: 他叫我們不要抽菸，自己卻抽。真是個偽君子！

ex.en: I don't want to be a hypocrite, so I try to practice what I preach.
ex.zh: 我不想當偽君子，所以我盡量言行一致。

ex.en: This is pure hypocrisy!
ex.zh: 這真是徹底的虛偽！

ex.en: People were angry at the hypocrisy of leaders who broke their own rules.
ex.zh: 領導人違反自己訂的規定，這種虛偽讓民眾很憤怒。

ex.en: Children quickly notice hypocrisy in the adults around them.
ex.zh: 孩子很快就會察覺身邊大人的虛偽。
